messages.subject: Re: plot stat_function giving range
parts:
On Sat, Sep 17, 2011 at 5:41 PM, defthym <dime...@gmail.com> wrote:
> I am trying to fit 3 different distributions , one for each category
> of the column "group" of the data below.
>
> first, I plot:
> qplot(day,geom = "density", colour=group,  data=ts2)
>
> and then I need three different functions, similar to:
> +stat_function(fun=dnorm,args=list(mean=18.764706,sd=24.524968))
>
> can I do this?

Yes, just use repeated stat_function calls. For example:

x <- rnorm(100, 19, 25)
qplot(x, geom="blank") +
stat_function(fun=dnorm,args=list(mean=18.764706,sd=24.524968)) +
stat_function(fun=dnorm,args=list(mean=14,sd=12))

Best,
